help.lead: Composer is a DAW: stacked track lanes on top, piano roll for the selected track below. World mode is the Growtopia-style tile view.

shortcut.space: Play / pause from the playhead · Shift+Space from the start
shortcut.clipboard: Copy / cut / paste at the playhead
shortcut.nudge: Nudge notes or playhead · Shift for 16ths
shortcut.accidentals: Hold while placing: Shift = sharp, Alt = flat (creates a matching layer if needed)
shortcut.editTool: Cycle Select / Draw / Slice · World also Build
shortcut.quantize: Quantize selected notes (or all) to the snap grid
shortcut.selectSame: Select same pitch on this track · Shift for the whole song
shortcut.ghost: Show or hide notes from other instruments
shortcut.replace: Retile selected notes with the current track’s instrument
shortcut.loopBraces: Composer: loop start / end at playhead · World: previous / next instrument
shortcut.worldPage: World: skip one Growtopia page (100 columns)

pianoRoll.title: Piano Roll
pianoRoll.body: Click empty to place a note (it will sound). Hold Shift for sharp or Alt for flat — it goes on a matching instrument layer, created if needed. Select tool: drag empty space to box-select. Draw tool: drag to paint a run of notes. Slice tool: click to split at that beat. Drag notes to move; drag the right edge to resize. The velocity lane under the roll sets how hard each note hits.

arrange.title: Arrange
arrange.body: Click a lane to select that track. Drag notes to move them in time and pitch. Drag empty space to box-select.

playhead.title: Playhead
playhead.body: Drag the triangle on the ruler (Composer) or the yellow caret (World) to seek. Shift-click the ruler to set loop start, Alt-click for loop end. Drag the yellow braces to resize the loop.

convert.title: Convert
convert.body: On MIDI import, pick Basic, Preserve, or Adapt ({esc} cancels). Basic snaps notes to the sheet. Preserve keeps the original melody shape and packs overlaps into Audio Racks. Adapt arranges the whole MIDI into Growtopia’s two-octave staff. Repeats and long rests use Repeat Begin/End. Sharps and flats get their own layer. File → Add MIDI layers (or the layers button next to + Track) appends one or more MIDI files onto the current song as main-instrument tracks; accidentals still split automatically.

worldTools.title: World tools
worldTools.body: Select is the pointer: drag to look, tap a tile to pick it, drag a tile to move it, Shift-drag to box-select. Draw paints a run of notes. Slice splits a note where you click. Build is World-only: place on empty cells and right-click to break. Hold Shift or Alt while placing for sharp or flat layers. Follow keeps the playhead in view — dragging peeks, then the camera eases back. On a phone, two-finger drag pans.

select.title: Select notes
select.body: Drag empty space to box-select. Shift-click adds, ⌘/Ctrl-click toggles. Drag a selected note to move the whole group. Arrows nudge; Delete removes.

phone.title: Phone
phone.body: World stays up front with a bottom dock. Composer tucks into a sheet (Arrange or Piano Roll). Tracks and weather live in the panel button.

hover.title: Hover (World)
hover.body: Shows the sheet music block, e.g. Sheet Music: Piano or Sheet Music: Flat Piano.

panels.title: Panels
panels.body: Drag the grip between Arrange and Piano Roll to resize. Minimize either panel from its header. World's side panel resizes from its left edge and can be minimized.

export.title: Export
export.body: Save keeps the song in this browser. Save as downloads a .notetopia file only NoteTopia can open. Export also offers GMSF for kixnoway.com, a Lua TXT blueprint (NoteTopia-only), .gtmusic, MIDI, JSON, MP3, and WAV. Mute and solo are respected on mixdown. GMSF columns pads empty columns at the end.

start.title: Getting started
start.lead: World sheet, tools, play, and save.

s1.title: Write on a sheet
s1.body: NoteTopia is a Growtopia music sheet with an optional DAW. This walkthrough points at the real controls. You can reopen it anytime from Help.

s2.title: Composer and World
s2.body: World is the 14-lane tile sheet. Composer is the piano roll and arrange view. Tab switches them.

s3.title: The sheet
s3.body: This is the song. Drag to look around. In Build, click empty tiles to place notes, or right-click to break them.

s4.title: Tools
s4.body: Build places tiles. Select looks around and picks. Draw paints a run. Slice splits a note. T cycles them.

s5.title: Layers
s5.body: Each instrument is a layer. Pick one to place, or add another with + Layer / + Track. MIDI layers land here too.

s6.title: Play
s6.body: Space plays from the playhead. Shift+Space plays from the start. The time display is also the BPM.

s7.title: Keep it
s7.body: Save stores the song in this browser. Export can download a NoteTopia file, GMSF for kixnoway.com, MIDI, or a mix.

midi.title: MIDI and layers
midi.lead: Open a .mid, convert it, or stack more parts.

s1.title: Open a file
s1.body: Open a .mid / .midi to convert onto the 14-lane sheet. .gtmusic and .GMSF drop in as Growtopia tiles.

s2.title: Pick a convert
s2.body: Basic is literal. Preserve keeps the melody shape. Adapt arranges the mix into Growtopia’s two octaves. You can change this later.

s3.title: Add MIDI layers
s3.body: Already have a song? Add MIDI layers stacks more files as extra instruments instead of replacing the sheet.

s4.title: They become tiles
s4.body: Each imported part shows up as a layer you can place, mute, or export. Overlaps can become Audio Racks.

sheet.title: Sheet to Growtopia
sheet.lead: Build the grid, then export GMSF.

s1.title: Stay on the grid
s1.body: Growtopia only hears what’s on this 14-lane sheet. Composer is for editing; World is what you copy in-game.

s2.title: Build the layout
s2.body: Use Build to stamp tiles. Select to move a group. Slice to split a long note. Hold Shift for sharps, Alt for flats.

s3.title: One block per cell
s3.body: Two notes in the same cell need an Audio Rack. Pack to racks from File if convert left overlaps on the sheet.

s4.title: Export GMSF
s4.body: Export GMSF opens in kixnoway.com. GMSF columns pads empty columns at the end. .gtmusic is the older text format. Lua TXT is a NoteTopia blueprint.

phone.title: On a phone
phone.lead: Dock, drag to look, Composer, and save.

s1.title: Phones are different
s1.body: This walkthrough is for iPhone and Android. World stays on the sheet. Drag with one finger to look around — same as Select on desktop.

s2.title: Bottom dock
s2.body: Select looks around and picks tiles. Build places and breaks them. Play sits in the middle. Help is the question mark.

s3.title: Drag to look
s3.body: Select is the default on a phone. Drag empty space to move the view. Tap a tile to pick it. Switch to Build when you want to stamp notes.

s4.title: Play
s4.body: The round button in the dock plays and pauses. BPM and extra tools sit in the floating bar above the dock.

s5.title: Composer
s5.body: The piano button opens Arrange. Drag empty space to pan, like World. Shrink the track list to icon + M/S if names are in the way.

s6.title: Keep it
s6.body: Save stores the song in this browser. New project wipes the sheet — you’ll be asked to save a .notetopia or GMSF first if there are notes.

welcome.heading: NoteTopia is free to use for planning music. Write in the browser, then see it as a Growtopia-style 14-lane sheet. Alpha, unofficial, not Ubisoft.
items: World Mode: 14-lane pitch grid, place/break tiles, weather (sunny, stargazing, nothingness, solid color), follow-playhead, density, and zoom.
World tools: Build, select, draw, slice. Shift for sharps, Alt for flats. Right-click breaks tiles.
Composer: DAW arrange plus a piano roll, mute/solo/volume, snap, resizable or minimized panes.
Simple mode (sheet planner) and Studio mode (full DAW + World). Phone layout with Arrange-first Composer.
Instruments: piano, bass, drums, sax, flute, Spanish guitar, electric guitar, violin, lyre, trumpet, spooky, Winterfest — flats/sharps where the game has them.
Audio Racks for stacked notes, accidental (sharp/flat) layers, Repeat Begin/End packing.
Import MIDI, .gtmusic, and .GMSF. Drag-and-drop. MIDI convert: Basic, Preserve, or Adapt. Add extra MIDI as layers on the current song.
Export a mix to MP3 or WAV (mute/solo respected), plus .GMSF for kixnoway, .gtmusic, Lua blueprint, .notetopia, and MIDI out.
Other tracks (G) ghosts notes from other instruments. Master volume with a VU meter. Loop region on the ruler.
Autosave in the browser, undo/redo, copy/paste/select-all, Night Chorus demo on first launch.
Tutorials, 20 languages, Help (?), and shortcuts (Space play, Tab modes, arrows, Ctrl+Z/C/V/A).
wip: Adapt convert is still experimental — Basic and Preserve are the stable ones.
More phone polish, smarter MIDI convert, and extra convert options.
Source stays private for now — not open source yet.
A shorter custom domain if/when I grab one.
Whatever else people yell at me about on Discord.

convert.body: Pick a convert method, then Convert.
convert.overlapHint: {count} overlapping tiles — Preserve packs these into Audio Racks.
convert.overlapHintSmart: {count} overlapping tiles — Adapt packs mixed instruments into Audio Racks and lowers the rack volume.
convert.longSheet: This file is longer than Growtopia’s {limit}-column sheet. Turn on Compress to pack it.
convert.compressHint: Loop repeats and empty pauses with Repeat Begin/End. Very long sheets also pack tighter.
convert.fitKeyHint: Transpose to fit the two-octave staff without jumping octaves.
convert.lowerHint: Move the melody lower on the staff when it still fits.
convert.skipDrumsHint: Leave percussion tracks out of the sheet.
convert.trimSilenceHint: Start the sheet at the first note instead of empty bars at the front.
convert.dropQuietHint: Ignore very soft MIDI hits so ghost notes don’t clutter the sheet.
convert.keyLockHint: Auto picks a chromatic shift that fits the two-octave staff. None keeps the original key and folds octaves per part.
convert.spellingHint: How black keys are written onto Growtopia natural lines.
convert.splitAccidentalsHint: Put sharps and flats on their own instrument layers. Off snaps everything to naturals.
convert.bellInstrumentHint: Where bells and music-box parts land.
convert.chordCapHint: Max notes kept on one track in the same column before racks.
convert.unisonHint: Keep the louder note when two hits share pitch and time.
convert.octaveDoublesHint: Keep one pitch class per column when the same note is doubled in octaves.
convert.padThinHint: How hard to thin long overlapping chords.
convert.melodyIsolationHint: Keep lead, bass, and drums. Drop pads and extra harmony.
convert.packRacksHint: Turn colliding notes into an Audio Rack (up to five voices, one volume).
convert.mixRackVolumeHint: Set the rack wrench volume from MIDI velocity.
convert.duckRacksHint: Lower the whole rack when more voices are stacked.
convert.maxRackVoicesHint: Growtopia racks cap at 5. Extra voices are dropped.
convert.sameInstrumentChordsHint: Keep piano-on-piano chords as stacked tiles, or pack them into a rack.
convert.neverRacksHint: Resolve overlaps by picking a winner instead of mixing.
convert.compactKitHint: Share lanes for hats, toms, and cymbals so the kit collides less.
convert.ghostHatVelocityHint: Hats softer than this are dropped.
convert.kickSnareHint: Drop hats on columns that already have a kick or snare.
convert.pickupTrimHint: Drop an incomplete first bar so the sheet starts on a downbeat.
convert.quietThresholdHint: MIDI velocities at or below this are dropped when Drop quiet notes is on.
convert.graceHint: Tiny quiet ornaments: drop them, keep them, or attach them to the next note.
convert.targetLengthHint: Pack the sheet until it fits this many world columns.
convert.minBpmHint: Stop halving tempo once it would drop below this.
convert.mergeInstrumentsHint: Combine converted tracks that share instrument and accidental layer.
convert.normalizeHint: Scale the loudest note to 100 and the rest with it.
convert.packingRacks: Packing {count} overlapping notes into Audio Racks…

v1.5-beta.label: Preserve
v1.5-beta.description: Keeps the original melody shape. Overlaps become Audio Racks.

v1.label: Basic
v1.description: Converts the MIDI to something simple. Other instruments may overlap each other.

v3-experimental.label: Adapt
v3-experimental.description: Arranges the whole MIDI into two octaves. Mixed overlaps become Audio Racks.
v3-experimental.hint: Adapt picks the real melody (usually piano, not a sax/clarinet double), keeps it in the singing register, and fits everything else into Growtopia's two-octave staff. Mixed instruments pack into Audio Racks. Open Options for presets and per-track control.

rack.title: Audio Rack
rack.placeHint: Up to 5 notes on one tile
rack.help: Each note is 3 characters: instrument (P piano, B bass, D drums, S sax, F flute, G guitar, V violin, L lyre, E electric, T trumpet), note A–G (lowercase = lower octave), then # sharp, - natural, or b flat. Spaces are optional. Up to 5 notes play at once.

midiLayer.body: Pick a main instrument for each file. Sharp and flat notes become extra layers automatically — you don’t pick those variants here.
midiLayer.extraLayers: Accidentals found ({kinds}) — extra layer(s) will be added.
midiLayer.noAccidentals: No sharps or flats in this file.
midiLayer.applyAll: Use this instrument for every file
midiLayer.method: Uses your last convert method ({name}). Change it on a full MIDI import.
